rationale: iter-3 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon vs reused Mayo DDPM v4 ckpt (ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt). ONE KNOB: recon_sample_steps (n_steps) 25 -> 32 (LONGER DDIM reverse trajectory). All else IDENTICAL to iter-2 (recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_dcstep_every=0 so the hard-CG projection stays OFF -> pure soft DPS; recon_eta_clamp=false; val_n=214). TRAJECTORY iter-1 (n_steps=25, eta=30): SSIM 0.3688, hr=0.0, PSNR 10.55, 868.65s/214 = 4.06 s/slice. iter-2 (n_steps=25, eta=5): SSIM 0.3960, hr=0.0, PSNR 11.25, 868.33s/214 = 4.06 s/slice. The eta 30->5 correction gave a SLIGHT lift (+0.027) but the recon is STILL FAR below the LD-FBP floor 0.8078 (and the constrained sibling REGRESSED on its eta fix eta30->1: 0.39->0.24), so the DPS guidance-gain lever is now EXHAUSTED. FAILURE MODE: the recon is dominated by a Mayo v4 DDPM prior that is MISMATCHED to the rebinned-Mayo distribution under the short 25-step low-T reverse budget -- per findings the prior is globally faithful (plausible CT texture) but NOT conditionally faithful to the input sino under DPS/DC (exactly the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict, where 4x-16x capacity + 2.5x training all stayed in the 0.3-0.5 SSIM band). ONE KNOB JUSTIFICATION: n_steps is the highest-value untried lever -- a longer DDIM reverse trajectory gives the soft-DPS prior more steps to settle from the FBP init toward the measurement manifold; the 25-step low-T budget may simply be too short to converge. BUDGET MATH (HARD 20-min = 1200s wall, val=ALL 214 L277 slices): per-step cost dominates (each of the n_steps reverse iterations does one DDPM-net forward + one projector forward + one autograd backward; dcstep_every=0 so NO extra CG cost), so per-slice cost is ~linear in n_steps with a small fixed FBP-init+IO offset. iter-2 = 4.06 s/slice at 25 steps. At 32 steps (worst-case fully-linear): 4.06*(32/25) = 5.20 s/slice -> 214*5.20 = 1112s = 18.5 min < 1200s wall (~88s headroom, MORE in practice because the fixed offset does not scale). Doubling to 50 steps (8.1 s/slice -> ~29 min) would BLOW the wall, so n_steps=32 (+28% trajectory) is the LARGEST step count that fits with margin -- the right budget-feasible probe, not a naive 2x. HYPOTHESIS: if I extend the DDIM trajectory 25 -> 32 steps, SSIM rises meaningfully above the iter-2 0.3960 because the longer reverse path lets the FBP-initialized iterate relax further onto the sino-consistent mode. FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays well below the FBP floor (~0.4 vs 0.81) even with the longer trajectory, then the Mayo v4 DDPM prior is STRUCTURALLY mismatched (not a step-budget issue) -> file a negative result and STOP iterating diffusion-recon on Mayo (the lever is the prior CLASS, not any sampler hyperparameter, mirroring the breast-DDPM decision).
